preamble: This image is a real in-engine frame from SANDLINE, a browser first-person shooter set in a desert oil refinery at dusk during an incoming sandstorm; the enemies are armoured combat robots and a giant four-legged walker called COLOSSUS. Keep the 3D scene, lighting, camera and composition of the input exactly as they are. Add a finished, shipping-quality game user interface on top of it, as a pixel-accurate UI mockup a front-end developer could rebuild with HTML/CSS/SVG: flat vector shapes, thin strokes, glows and blurs only, no 3D UI objects, no extra characters or weapons.
rules: All text in English, spelled exactly as written above, crisp and legible. 16:9 frame, UI kept inside a 4% safe margin. Do not add watermarks, logos of real companies, or controller button glyphs. Do not repaint or restyle the scene itself beyond the stated overlay effects.

directions.name: VISOR (tactical helmet display)
directions.style: The player sees through a combat helmet visor. Warm amber and off-white monochrome HUD with one red alert colour; hair-thin lines, small caps monospace micro-labels, slightly curved elements that follow the visor curvature near the frame edges, faint visor glass reflections and corner vignette, subtle scanline and chromatic fringe on UI only. Feels like a military heads-up display: precise, quiet, expensive. Typography: wide geometric sans for big words, monospace for data.

directions.name: HOLO (cold hologram)
directions.style: Clean cold-cyan and white holographic interface with a hot orange accent for danger, floating translucent panels with fine hex-grid texture, bright thin outlines with soft glow, angled 45-degree cut corners, small tick marks and brackets, light glitch slices. Feels like a high-budget sci-fi shooter HUD: luminous, sharp, futuristic. Typography: tall condensed sans for big words, light technical sans for data.

directions.name: HAZARD (industrial brutalist)
directions.style: Bold industrial graphic design: heavy condensed black-weight type, solid blocks of signal orange and bone white on near-black bars, black-and-yellow hazard stripes used sparingly, stencil numerals, thick rules, big confident numbers, crop marks and part-number microtext. Feels like heavy machinery warning plates turned into a game UI: loud, graphic, unmistakable. Typography: ultra-condensed grotesque for big words, stencil for numbers.

boards.name: TITLE SCREEN / MAIN MENU
boards.layout: Darken the scene slightly and let it read as a live background. Huge game logo 'SANDLINE' taking about 55% of frame width on the left-centre, with a one-line premise under it: 'HOLD THE REFINERY. THE STORM IS BRINGING SOMETHING BIG.' Under that a vertical menu of four items: 'DEPLOY' (highlighted, selected, with a selection marker), 'LOADOUT', 'SETTINGS', 'CONTROLS'. Bottom-left: small key legend 'WASD MOVE   MOUSE AIM   LMB FIRE   G GRENADE   SHIFT DASH   E INTERACT'. Top-right: small status block 'SECTOR 7 // KHARA BASIN', 'STORM FRONT 4.2 KM', 'DUSK 18:42'. Bottom-right: tiny line 'EVERY MODEL GENERATED WITH HI3D'.

boards.name: IN-COMBAT HUD
boards.layout: Top-centre: a compass strip with degree ticks, heading 'NE 048', and two objective diamonds on it labelled 'A 62M' and 'B 118M'. Top-left: objective tracker 'ACT 1 // HOLD THE YARD' with a line 'DESTROY THE SIGNAL RELAYS' and three small boxes showing 1 of 3 done, plus 'HOSTILES 6'. Top-right: a small circular radar with a few red blips and a storm countdown 'STORM FRONT 01:12'. Bottom-left: segmented shield bar (2 of 4 segments left) above a segmented health bar with the number '84', and two ability icons with cooldown rings labelled 'DASH' and 'SCAN'. Bottom-right: big ammo count '24' with small '/ 180', a row of 30 bullet ticks partially spent, weapon name 'AR-7 CARBINE', and grenade pips 'GL x3'. Centre: a thin dynamic crosshair with a small hit-marker X, and a floating enemy tag over the nearest robot: a bracket around it with a thin health bar and 'RIFLEMAN 23M'. Right side, under the radar: a kill feed line 'CHARGER DOWN +100'. Bottom-centre: a radio subtitle line 'CONTROL: Relay two is behind the tank farm. Move.' A faint red directional damage arc on the left of the crosshair.

boards.name: BOSS REVEAL
boards.layout: Cinematic letterbox bars top and bottom. The giant walker is being introduced: a large name card on the lower-left reading 'COLOSSUS' in huge letters with a small line above it 'CLASS-IV SIEGE WALKER' and a line below 'THREAT LEVEL: EXTREME'. Thin target-analysis callout lines pointing at two glowing spots on the machine's body labelled 'COOLANT CORE', at a leg joint labelled 'LEG ACTUATOR', and at the front labelled 'BEAM EMITTER'. Top-centre: a wide segmented boss health bar with 'COLOSSUS' label, full. Top-left: 'ACT 3 // KILL THE COLOSSUS'. A scanning sweep line crossing the machine, and a warning strip 'WARNING // MASSIVE CONTACT' at the top-right. Bottom-centre radio subtitle: 'CONTROL: That is not on any manifest. Hit the coolant cores.'
